risks.title: Loss or misuse of data
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in the principal risk profile (Item 1A). Strong language ("cyber attacks", "material loss", "substantial legal liability"). Trend of "increasing risk" explicitly mentioned. Critical weight: direct impact on EBIT, reputation, and regulatory compliance.

risks.title: New legislation and regulatory changes
risks.score_rationale: Second principal risk in the profile. Strong language ("heightened regulatory scrutiny", "increased costs", "brand damage"). Trend of "increasing risk and increasing costs". Direct impact on EBIT and ROCE. Context: UK FCA (interim permission since April 2014), evolving global data protection rules.

risks.title: Material regulatory actions and adverse litigation
risks.score_rationale: Principal risk explicitly detailed. Serious language ("civil or criminal penalties", "negative publicity", "class actions"). Trend of "risk continues to increase" with documented rise in US class actions in 2015. Impact on EBIT and reputation. Context: ongoing litigation in the US, UK, Brazil.

risks.title: Increased competition and loss of market share
risks.score_rationale: Principal risk in the profile. Moderate-to-strong language ("superior products", "lower prices", "market share"). Trend of "increasing risk, resulting from new entrants". Impact on EBIT, ROCE, and organic growth. Context: new market entrants, reinvention of traditional players, massive technology investments.

risks.title: Data ownership, access and integrity
risks.score_rationale: Principal risk in the profile. Moderate language ("changed or restricted", "materially adverse effect"). Trend of "risk has remained stable". Impact on EBIT and operating results. Context: reliance on data suppliers, consumer privacy concerns, and data accuracy.

risks.title: Dependence on highly skilled talent
risks.score_rationale: Principal risk in the profile. Moderate language ("unable to attract", "reasonable compensation"). Trend of "risk has remained stable". Impact on employee engagement and operational capacity. Context: highly competitive data science and technology sector.

risks.title: Non-resilient or non-agile IT environment
risks.score_rationale: Principal risk in the profile. Strong language ("rapidly changing", "material loss", "interruption"). Trend of "risk has remained stable". Impact on EBIT and ROCE. Context: 21% of total costs in IT/data, critical dependence on systems.

risks.title: Business conduct risk and client compliance
risks.score_rationale: New principal risk added in 2015 ("new principal risk"). Moderate-to-strong language ("inappropriate execution", "material loss", "regulatory enforcement"). Trend of "new principal risk". Impact on EBIT, ROCE, and reputation. Context: UK FCA expectations on conduct risk management (from April 2016).

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the 2015 annual report. The company focuses on data, analytics, and traditional credit services.
